title: Why My Grandma Never Opens the Door on the Second Knock 😨
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. Would you have opened it? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Never open the door on the second knock.
First knock, she opens it. The milkman, the neighbours, me.
Second knock, she turns off the TV and sits very still.
I thought it was an old village habit.
And Grandma's voice came through the door.
*Grandma was standing behind me, finger on her lips.
That's why she never answers the second knock.
The second one always sounds like family.
